messages:
OpsPager: :rotating_light: Pager — GPU pool eu-west-1 reports 95% utilization and sustained queue growth. Autoscaler observed scale-up failures: 'max nodes reached' and repeated provider API 403/Quota errors. Symptoms: generation latency > 2.5s P95, intermittent 429 responses for heavy tenants. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/incident/7954321122

Sam (oncall): I'm on it. Assigned to me via incident-bot. Can someone confirm if Dedicated capacity quotas were recently changed?

incident-bot: incident 7954321122 assigned -> Sam (oncall). Bridge created: https://meet.redwood.ai/7954321122-bridge

Mai (infra): seeing repeated errors from cloud provider: 
```
ERROR autoscaler: scaleUp rejected: requested 20 nodes, quotaExceeded: GPU quota 40 -> 32
```
We hit an account-level GPU quota for eu-west-1. Provider console shows 0 pending approvals.

Arya (runtime): Autoscaler logic tries burst to meet queue backlog but we have a hard cap in pool config (max_nodes=32). We should be able to fallback to cross-region routing but policy currently prefers same-region for affinity.

Jules (cs): Heads-up — two large customers reported timeouts ~10:10 UTC, support channel heating up. I'm templating a message.

Sam (oncall): Quick mitigation plan: 1) divert new traffic for non-latency-critical tenants to eu-central-1 2) enable emergency-burst capacity from reserved pool if possible 3) throttle embeddings-heavy clients 4) request quota increase/approve in provider console. Who can run the routing change?

Arya (runtime): I can flip regional routing rule. Patch command: 
```
# set fallback region for eu-west-1 to eu-central-1
redwoodctl routing update --pool eu-west-1 --fallback-region eu-central-1 --priority off-peak
```
I'll apply with canary 10% first.

Mai (infra): I can attempt to temporarily raise pool max_nodes to 48 to let autoscaler request more nodes, but provider quota will still block. However, swapping some ephemeral workloads off eu-west-1 will free quota. I'm going to identify lowest-priority tenants and evict.

Sam (oncall): Eviction list please. Also execute throttling rules for embeddings endpoints: set rate-limit for client-tier "free" to 10rps.

Mai (infra): Evict command (dry run first): 
```
redwoodctl pool drain --pool eu-west-1 --selector tenant:burstable --dry-run
```
I'll promote to real drain in 2m if no objections.

Jules (cs): Please hold on evictions for any customer with an active support ticket. I'll post IDs to #support.

Sam (oncall): Go ahead with canary routing and throttles. Notify customers after mitigation. I'll coordinate quota request with provider tickets.

deploy-bot: Can confirm: failed scale-up retries at 10:12:07 UTC (x14). Last successful node creation at 09:58:02 UTC.

Arya (runtime): Canary routing applied at 10:14 UTC -> 10% traffic to eu-central-1. Observed immediate drop in queue growth for the canary tenants. Rolling to 30% now.

Mai (infra): Drained 8 low-priority tenants from eu-west-1 at 10:17 UTC -> freed 12 GPUs. Autoscaler retried and successfully launched 4 nodes at 10:20 UTC. Queue backlog started decreasing.

Sam (oncall): Throttles applied: free-tier embeddings limited to 10rps at 10:18 UTC. Monitor for customer impact.

Jules (cs): Sent interim customer message to affected accounts at 10:22 UTC. No escalations yet.

Mai (infra): Provider quota request submitted at 10:21 UTC (ticket 432198). ETA unknown. Meanwhile we've rebalanced and enabled emergency-burst from reserved pool to cover shortfall.

Sam (oncall): Observability: P95 latency down from 2.8s to 1.1s by 10:28 after mitigations. 429 rate dropped to baseline. Marking incident as under control.

incident-bot: incident status -> under_control. Incident responders: Sam, Mai, Arya, Jules.

Sam (oncall): Postmortem notes start: Impact - eu-west-1 pool hit account GPU quota; autoscaler had conservative fallback (regional affinity) and pool max_nodes cap prevented immediate recovery; queue growth caused latency/429s for some tenants for ~30m window. Root causes: quota limit + pool config and routing policy that delayed cross-region fallback.

Arya (runtime): Immediate action items (short):
- Enable faster cross-region fallback for pool if scale-up fails for >30s (rollback to canary threshold 5% -> 25% faster).
- Add an autoscaler metric alert when scale-up is rejected by provider (quotaExceeded) -> pages infra.

Mai (infra): Infra action items:
- Request permanent GPU quota increase for eu-west-1 (submit form + follow-up) Ticket: 432198.
- Remove overly conservative max_nodes=32 from eu-west-1 pool or make it auto-synced with provider limits.
- Add a dashboard tile for available GPU quota per region.

Jules (cs): Customer / comms action items:
- Follow-up email to affected customers with timeline and mitigation steps.
- CS playbook update to surface queue/backpressure symptoms earlier.

Sam (oncall): Longer-term (owners assigned):
- Arya -> change routing policy for faster fallback (RFC in two weeks).
- Mai -> ensure pool config isn't out of sync with cloud quotas (audit + automation).
- Sam -> incident runbook update and add examples for quota-induced scale failures.

Sam (oncall): Final notes: incident declared at 10:10 UTC, mitigations in place by 10:28 UTC, fully stabilized by 10:35 UTC. Total customer-impact window ~25 minutes for most tenants, some experienced 429s for ~8 minutes.

incident-bot: Incident 7954321122 closed to active response mode; follow-ups scheduled in #postmortems.

Sam (oncall): Filing postmortem doc and will add logs/graphs. Thanks all for quick coordination :thumbsup:

Jules (cs): Great job everyone. I'll track comms until quota ticket resolves.

Mai (infra): I'll follow up with provider and update ticket. Leaving a note for runbook edits.

Arya (runtime): Posting the small autoscaler patch now to reduce fallback delay. Patch PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/3712

Sam (oncall): Closing thread.
